testEnvironment: Windows 10/11; Java 17; Maven Wrapper; JUnit 5; Mockito; JaCoCo; Google Sheets API.

methods.description: Partially update a class while enforcing lifecycle, permission, capacity, commercial-history and session-synchronization rules.
methods.preCondition: Class repositories, current user, audit log and ClassSessionScheduleService are mocked.

cases.scenario: The PATCH request contains no provided field.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown before the class row is locked.

cases.scenario: The client attempts to set a lifecycle status directly.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown and no class is saved.

cases.scenario: Capacity is reduced below the number of active trainees.
cases.expected: CLASS_CAPACITY_INVALID is thrown.

cases.scenario: Price is changed after enrollment or payment history exists.
cases.expected: CONFLICT is thrown and no class is saved.

cases.scenario: A valid weekly schedule is changed for an upcoming class.
cases.expected: Definition is validated, class is saved, future sessions are synchronized and CLASS_UPDATED is audited.

cases.scenario: Updated dates move an upcoming class into the completed lifecycle.
cases.input: startDate and endDate are both in the past.
cases.expected: Status becomes COMPLETED; future sessions are deleted and are not rebuilt.

methods.description: Parse a weekly schedule, generate future sessions, detect trainer conflicts and reconcile saved sessions without rewriting history.
methods.preCondition: ClassSessionRepository is mocked; ObjectMapper is real; dates are generated relative to the execution day.

cases.scenario: The class has no weekly schedule JSON.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST with 'Class schedule is required'.

cases.scenario: Two slots on the same day overlap.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown before sessions are saved.

cases.scenario: The trainer already teaches another class at an overlapping time.
cases.input: Desired 09:00-10:00; existing 09:30-10:30 on the same date.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST reports the trainer conflict.

cases.scenario: A valid one-day schedule has no existing session or trainer conflict.
cases.expected: One ClassSession is saved with the class and trainer IDs.

cases.scenario: One future session still matches the schedule and another is stale.
cases.expected: The matching row receives the current trainer; the stale row is deleted.

methods.description: Build and classify the authenticated trainee's online-course and class progress from effective curriculum data.
methods.preCondition: Current user, enrollment, curriculum, progress and assignment dependencies are mocked.

cases.scenario: The trainee has no enrolled online course or class.
cases.expected: All totals are zero and all result lists are empty.

cases.scenario: An online course has one published and completed lesson.
cases.input: One online enrollment and one completed VIDEO lesson.
cases.expected: The course is 100% and appears in completedCourseItems.

cases.scenario: The trainee has one completed online course and one half-completed class.
cases.expected: Total=2, completed=1, in-progress=1 and class overall progress=50%.

methods.description: Detect whether a PATCH request explicitly contains at least one supported class field.
methods.preCondition: A real UpdateClassRequest instance is used; no dependency is mocked.

cases.scenario: No setter has been invoked.
cases.expected: hasAnyField returns false.

cases.scenario: The client explicitly provides a nullable field with null.
cases.expected: hasAnyField returns true and meetingUrlProvided is true.

methods.description: Store the schedule value and record that the PATCH field was explicitly provided.
methods.preCondition: A real UpdateClassRequest instance is used.

cases.scenario: A non-null weekly schedule is provided.
cases.expected: The value is stored and scheduleDescriptionProvided is true.

cases.scenario: The schedule field is explicitly sent as null.
cases.expected: The value remains null but the request is not treated as empty.

methods.description: Distinguish an omitted meeting URL from an explicitly provided meeting URL.
methods.preCondition: A real UpdateClassRequest instance is used.

cases.scenario: The request changes from omitted meeting URL to a valid provided URL.
cases.input: New request, then setMeetingUrl(valid Google Meet URL).
cases.expected: The flag changes from false to true and the URL is retained.

methods.description: Resolve class lifecycle status against an explicit business date while preserving cancellation.
methods.preCondition: A fixed reference date of 2026-07-28 is used.

cases.scenario: A cancelled class is within its scheduled date range.
cases.expected: CANCELLED is preserved.

cases.scenario: Dates represent future, current-day and expired classes.
cases.expected: UPCOMING, ONGOING and COMPLETED are resolved respectively.

cases.scenario: Required dates are missing or end date precedes start date.
cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException explains the invalid date.

methods.description: Resolve status using the current date in the configured business zone.
methods.preCondition: Test dates are generated relative to ClassLifecycle.today().

cases.scenario: One class starts tomorrow and another ended yesterday.
cases.expected: The classes resolve to UPCOMING and COMPLETED.

methods.description: Return the current calendar date in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
methods.preCondition: The expected date is sampled immediately before and after the method call.

cases.scenario: The call may occur around a date boundary.
cases.expected: The result is between the two Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh date samples.

methods.description: Convert ClassStatus enum values to the lowercase PostgreSQL representation.
methods.preCondition: A real converter instance is used.

cases.scenario: Valid enum values are persisted.
cases.expected: upcoming and cancelled are returned.

cases.scenario: The entity attribute is null.
cases.expected: null is returned.

methods.description: Convert database status text to ClassStatus without case sensitivity.
methods.preCondition: A real converter instance is used.

cases.scenario: Database text uses lowercase or mixed case.
cases.expected: ONGOING and COMPLETED are returned.

cases.scenario: The database value is null or outside the enum.
cases.expected: null is preserved and archived raises IllegalArgumentException.

methods.description: Map active enrollment native-query rows into student analytics records.
methods.preCondition: EntityManager and native Query are mocked.

cases.scenario: The query returns UUID text, strings and a SQL timestamp.
cases.expected: The row is converted to UUID, text and Instant fields.

methods.description: Calculate assignment counts, rates, average score, late work and pending grading.
methods.preCondition: EntityManager and native Query are mocked.

cases.scenario: Two assignments and two active students yield four expected submissions.
cases.expected: Submission rate is 75.00 and all counts are mapped.

cases.scenario: There are no assignments or active students.
cases.input: All counts zero and average score null.
cases.expected: Rate is zero and null average score is preserved.

methods.description: Map per-student learning activity, score and late-submission native-query results.
methods.preCondition: EntityManager and native Query are mocked.

cases.scenario: One student has complete statistics and one has null aggregates.
cases.expected: Values and nulls are mapped without fabricating scores.

methods.description: Create a class only for a published course and active trainer, then build sessions and audit.
methods.preCondition: Repositories, current user, schedule service and audit service are mocked.

cases.scenario: A valid future class is created.
cases.input: Published course, active trainer, valid Meet URL, dates, capacity and price.
cases.expected: The class is normalized, saved, synchronized and audited as upcoming.

cases.scenario: The selected course is still draft.
cases.expected: BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION is thrown before saving.

methods.description: Restore cancelled classes with lifecycle, capacity, course, trainer and session rules.
methods.preCondition: Class, enrollment, course, trainer, schedule and audit dependencies are mocked.

cases.scenario: A cancelled class is restored with future dates.
cases.input: Valid published course, active trainer and capacity.
cases.expected: Status becomes UPCOMING and future sessions are rebuilt.

cases.scenario: A cancelled class is restored with dates that already ended.
cases.expected: Status becomes COMPLETED and future sessions are deleted.

cases.scenario: An upcoming class is sent to the restore endpoint.
cases.expected: CONFLICT is thrown and no class is saved.

methods.description: Authorize through ClassAdminService and build class-level metrics plus a filtered student page.
methods.preCondition: Class services, analytics repository and progress service are mocked.

cases.scenario: Two active students have different progress and activity dates.
cases.expected: Average is 62.5, inactive count is one and summary remains unfiltered.

cases.scenario: The client sends an unsupported progress filter.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown.

methods.description: Authorize analytics through the trainer's assigned-class lookup.
methods.preCondition: ClassTrainerService and analytics dependencies are mocked.

cases.scenario: The assigned class has no active students.
cases.expected: Trainer authorization is used, page becomes zero and size is capped at 100.

methods.description: Validate trainer, dates, schedule JSON and the existence of at least one future session.
methods.preCondition: ObjectMapper is real and ClassSessionRepository is mocked.

cases.scenario: No trainer is selected.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST asks the user to select a trainer.

cases.scenario: A valid one-slot schedule creates a session tomorrow.
cases.expected: Validation completes without persistence.

cases.scenario: All configured dates are in the past.
cases.input: Start and end date were yesterday.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST reports that no future session can be created.

methods.description: Delete only sessions that have not started, preserving history.
methods.preCondition: ClassSessionRepository is mocked; dates are relative to execution day.

cases.scenario: The repository returns one historical and one future session.
cases.expected: Only tomorrow's session is deleted.

cases.scenario: There is no mutable session.
cases.expected: deleteAll is not called.

methods.description: List only the authenticated trainer's classes with normalized filters and bounded pagination.
methods.preCondition: CurrentUserService and ClassOfferingRepository are mocked.

cases.scenario: Filters contain spaces and SQL LIKE wildcard characters; size exceeds limit.
cases.expected: Status is normalized, keyword is escaped and size is capped at 100.

cases.scenario: An unsupported status is requested.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown.

methods.description: Return class detail only when it is assigned to the authenticated trainer.
methods.preCondition: CurrentUserService and ClassOfferingRepository are mocked.

cases.scenario: The assigned class is over capacity.
cases.expected: Detail is returned and available seats are clamped to zero.

cases.scenario: The repository cannot find this class for the trainer.
cases.expected: RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND is thrown.

methods.description: Exchange a refresh token for an access token and create a Google Meet space with guarded configuration.
methods.preCondition: System settings are mocked and both HTTP services use MockRestServiceServer.

cases.scenario: OAuth and Meet endpoints both return successful JSON.
cases.input: Configured credentials and fake provider responses.
cases.expected: The Bearer token is used and the trimmed meeting URL is returned.

cases.scenario: Google Meet generation is disabled.
cases.expected: EXTERNAL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is thrown before any HTTP call.

cases.scenario: The refresh token is blank.
cases.expected: EXTERNAL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE reports incomplete configuration.

methods.description: Validate dynamic opening-class filters, escape keyword patterns and map bounded paged results.
methods.preCondition: ClassOfferingRepository is mocked.

cases.scenario: Keyword contains SQL LIKE symbols, requested size is large and class is full.
cases.expected: Keyword is escaped, size is 100 and available slots are zero.

cases.scenario: Date or price range is reversed.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown for each invalid range.

methods.description: Validate class ID and return only a class exposed by the opening-schedule query.
methods.preCondition: ClassOfferingRepository is mocked.

cases.scenario: No class ID is supplied.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown.

cases.scenario: The opening class exists and has no active enrollment count.
cases.expected: Active count becomes zero and available slots are 30.

cases.scenario: The ID does not identify an opening class.
cases.expected: RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND is thrown.

methods.description: Resolve the trainee's Monday-to-Sunday window and map visible enrolled-class sessions.
methods.preCondition: CurrentUserService and ClassSessionRepository are mocked.

cases.scenario: A Wednesday is requested and one Friday session exists.
cases.expected: Window is 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-02 and the session is mapped.

cases.scenario: The client omits the reference date.
cases.expected: The current business-server week is used.

methods.description: Enforce TRAINER/TMO schedule scope and resolve the selected trainer.
methods.preCondition: Current user, user repository and session repository are mocked.

cases.scenario: A trainer passes another trainer ID.
cases.expected: The actor ID is used and the requested ID is ignored.

cases.scenario: TMO selects an existing active trainer.
cases.expected: Trainer validity is checked and their sessions are returned.

cases.scenario: An unsupported role requests the staff schedule.
cases.expected: FORBIDDEN is thrown.

methods.description: Calculate weighted class progress from published lesson, quiz and flashcard completion.
methods.preCondition: Curriculum resolution and lesson-progress repository are mocked.

cases.scenario: The effective curriculum has no content.
cases.input: No lessons and no progress rows.
cases.expected: Progress is zero.

cases.scenario: Lesson and flashcard are complete while quiz is incomplete.
cases.expected: Weighted overall progress is 75%.

cases.scenario: A completed published lesson exists beside an uncompleted draft lesson.
cases.input: One PUBLISHED and one DRAFT video.
cases.expected: Only published content is counted, producing 100%.

methods.description: Create or update progress in the correct online/class curriculum scope and enforce course-class consistency.
methods.preCondition: Current user, curriculum, class and progress dependencies are mocked.

cases.scenario: The trainee completes an online lesson with no previous row.
cases.expected: A new online progress row is saved with completion timestamps.

cases.scenario: The requested course does not own the selected class.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown before curriculum resolution.

cases.scenario: An existing completed online lesson is unchecked.
cases.expected: completedAt is cleared and lastAccessedAt is refreshed.
